manualImageFlow.cache: main misses; item preview, group detail, first viewer, and repeated viewer hit
manualImageFlow.deletion: viewer closed and main recovered while shared referenced assets remained
manualImageFlow.missingAsset: imageCacheMiss failure and imageError were recorded without stale imageReady

rankedFindings.finding: Repeated viewer paint was dominated by the macOS maximize transition, not Rust window calls or image decoding.
rankedFindings.evidence: viewerNativeVisible followed viewerRequest by about 1 ms while viewerPainted remained about 400 ms later

rankedFindings.finding: Prewarmed preview paint is bounded by the existing pointer and paint cadence near 50 ms.
rankedFindings.evidence: text, file, and image shell medians remained 47-51 ms with image cache hits below the 120 ms budget

rankedFindings.finding: Resident main show and native visibility are already low cost.
rankedFindings.evidence: hot main median was 18-22 ms and no same-frame duplicate show request was observed

acceptedChanges: Retain a hidden maximized viewer so repeated opens avoid another native maximize animation.
Set focusable, decorations, and shadow only in the auxiliary descriptor at creation time.
Use a shared LaunchServices primary launcher so macOS benchmark runs avoid parent-process AppKit registration aborts.

noChangeDecisions.css: The shared stylesheet is 6.89 KiB gzip and no style, layout, paint, or compositing evidence justified fragmentation.
noChangeDecisions.reactMemoization: Trace and source audit showed no repeated component commit bottleneck, so no memo wrappers were added.
noChangeDecisions.previewGeometry: Live monitor geometry, preview X preservation, pointer polling, and zero-debounce behavior remain unchanged.
